papers.title_en: Data-Driven Nonlinear Observer Design Using the Koopman Generator
papers.authors: Joachim Deutscher
papers.evidence: 基于Koopman生成元的非线性观测器设计
papers.tldr: 针对非线性连续时间系统观测器设计依赖模型且数据驱动实现缺乏误差保证的问题，本文利用Koopman生成元构造含线性系统部分与非线性输出注入的观测器，输出注入引入额外自由度以保持字典不变或降低投影误差。随后扩展到有输入系统，结合生成元EDMD形成数据驱动设计，并推导有限数据下观测器误差动态与稳态观测误差的概率界。不变与非不变字典算例验证了有效性，为数据驱动非线性观测器提供了有理论保证的途径。
papers.abstract_en: This paper deals with the data-driven design of nonlinear continuous-time observers using the Koopman generator. For systems without inputs, an observer is designed that consists of a linear system part with a nonlinear output injection. Therein, the output injection introduces additional degrees of freedom to ensure an invariant dictionary or a small projection error. Subsequently, this observer is extended to systems with inputs. These results form the basis for a data-driven nonlinear observer design using generator extended dynamic mode decomposition. Probabilistic finite-data error bounds are derived for the observer error w.r.t. the data-driven observer error dynamics and for the corresponding steady-state observation error. Examples of nonlinear systems with invariant and non-invariant dictionaries illustrate the effectiveness of the novel data-driven observer design procedure.

papers.title_en: $ζ_0$: A Framework for World Action Models with Joint Scene and Body Foresight in Humanoid Control
papers.authors: Yizhi Chen, Zhanxiang Cao, Yitong Wang, Junyu Liu, Hongchu Zeng, Xinyi Peng, Chuxuan Huang, Yicheng Su, Zihao Zhou, Shengcheng Fu, Haoyang Li, Liyun Yan, Tianyue Zhan, Jianming Ma, Yang Zhang, Keqi Zhu, Xiaxi Si, Jinming Yao, Qiao Sun, Shizeng Zhang, Jiangwei Zhong, Yue Gao
papers.evidence: 面向人形控制、预见身体运动的世界动作模型框架
papers.tldr: 人形机器人交互不仅依赖视觉结果，也依赖本体关节响应，但现有 World Action Models 主要预测视觉未来，潜空间距离损失又无法直接监督动作响应。ζ0 将 VLA 策略扩展为世界动作模型，在共享潜表示中同时预见未来视觉特征与实测关节轨迹，并用教师参考响应和双响应迁移联合训练因果预测器，部署时仅用因果预测未来。在 HumanoidArena 七个任务上，基于 Ψ0 和 GR00T N1.7 分别达 63.6% 和 79.5% 平均成功率，较基座提升 18.8 和 9.0 点；六个真实任务达 78.3% 和 85.0%，提升 16.7 和 10.0 点。
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models anticipate visual outcomes to guide robot actions, yet humanoid interaction also depends on how the robot's body responds. Visual foresight alone can miss body motion, while latent-distance losses do not directly supervise action responses. We present $ζ_0$, a framework that turns vision-language-action policies into World Action Models by foreseeing future visual features and measured joint trajectories in a shared latent representation. During training, a teacher conditioned on recorded futures provides a reference action response, and dual-response transfer trains the causal predictor to match it through the teacher and the executing policy. All components are trained jointly, and deployment uses only causally predicted futures. On seven HumanoidArena tasks, $ζ_0$ built on $Ψ_0$ and GR00T N1.7 reaches 63.6% and 79.5% mean success, 18.8 and 9.0 points above these bases. On six real-world tasks, it reaches 78.3% and 85.0%, gains of 16.7 and 10.0 points. On GR00T, its 79.5% tops all compared seven-task joint policies. Project page: https://chenyizhi123.github.io/zeta0-project/

papers.title_en: CHAMP: Coordinated Humanoid Loco-Manipulation with Whole-Body Motion Priors
papers.authors: Lijun Han, Muyuan Ma, Zichen Wang, Siyuan Liu, Yuxi Liu, Yutong Wang, Bohao Zhang, Heng Zhou, Wei Sui
papers.evidence: 基于全身运动先验的人形机器人移动操作
papers.tldr: 人形机器人需协调全身移动与灵巧操作，但从异构数据学习可用的全身运动先验并落地控制仍困难。CHAMP先用约2298小时人机数据预训练视觉语言模型预测未来身体与手部运动，并以共享表征统一不同具身的全身运动学习；再用协调导向动作专家CAE通过稀疏路由融合多层特征，联合生成身体与手动作。实验在七项仿真和七项真实任务上分别达84.8%和91.4%成功率，长时爆米花递送任务达70.0%。
papers.abstract_en: Coordinating locomotion and dexterous manipulation is fundamental to humanoid robots operating in human environments. A key challenge is learning motion priors from diverse data and using them effectively for coordinated robot control. We present CHAMP, a unified framework for humanoid loco-manipulation that combines whole-body motion pretraining with adaptive feature extraction. CHAMP pretrains a vision-language model to predict future body and hand motion from approximately 2,298 hours of heterogeneous human and robot data. A shared motion representation enables unified whole-body motion learning across embodiments from datasets with body annotations, hand annotations, or both. To ground these motion priors in robot control, we introduce a Coordination-oriented Action Expert (CAE) and train it on replay data generated using the target controller. Through sparse routing, CAE adaptively selects, transforms, and fuses features from multiple layers of the pretrained model to jointly generate body and hand actions. In experiments, CHAMP achieves overall success rates of 84.8% on seven simulated tasks and 91.4% on seven real-world tasks with a Unitree G1, outperforming the evaluated baselines in both settings. In particular, CHAMP achieves 70.0% success on the long-horizon popcorn-serving task, compared with 40.0% for the best-performing baseline.

papers.title_en: Let The Pixels Through: Rethinking Long Skip Connections for Scalable Pixel Diffusion
papers.authors: Jiachen Lei, Jiahong Wu, XiangXiang Chu
papers.evidence: 重新审视U-Net中长跳跃连接以改进像素扩散去噪器
papers.tldr: 像素扩散模型训练依赖经验配方且对超参敏感。作者重新审视U-Net长跳连，发现其优化收益并非去噪必需，线性融合也难以适配不同噪声水平；于是提出非对称长跳连与adaGLU解码器模块，构成简洁的像素扩散Transformer。模型从零训练可平滑扩展至1.6B参数，在ImageNet-256/512取得1.62/1.70 FID，并原生支持文本、图像等多模态条件，为可扩展像素扩散提供新设计。
papers.abstract_en: Training pixel diffusion models remains less straightforward, owing to the ad hoc training recipes and architecture designs, along with the sensitivity to hyper-parameter choices. We show that strong denoisers can be built by refining existing pixel-native designs from the literature. Specifically, we revisit the long skip connection in U-Net and find that the optimization benefit commonly attributed to it is not necessary for its denoising benefit. We further find that the conventional linear combination of features from the skip and main backbone is inadequate for regimes of various noise levels. Motivated by these observations, we introduce two core modifications. First, we adopt asymmetric long skips, which propagate fine-grained information from input embeddings to decoder layers. Second, we introduce adaGLU, a SwiGLU-like MLP block, in decoder layers to adaptively filter information from the embeddings before being added to main-branch features. The above designs give a simple pixel diffusion transformer architecture. When trained from scratch, it scales smoothly from small-scale baselines up to 1.6B parameters, achieving 1.62 and 1.70 FID on ImageNet-256 and -512, respectively. Besides, it natively supports multimodal inputs, such as text and images, yielding competitive performance in text-to-image generation. We release our codes at https://github.com/AMAP-ML/PiT

papers.title_en: Convex computation of cost bounds for data-driven nonlinear optimal control
papers.authors: Oumayma Khattabi, Matteo Tacchi-Benard, Sorin Olaru
papers.evidence: 最优控制的HJB方程凸松弛求解
papers.tldr: 针对输入仿射多项式系统中状态相关输入矩阵未知、控制有效性不确定的数据驱动非线性最优控制难题，作者在数据存在与未知动态Lipschitz连续假设下构造不确定性集，将HJB方程改写为数据驱动形式。通过求解最佳情形，得到反馈控制策略可实现成本的下界。进一步把问题松弛为矩-SoS层级半定规划，从矩原问题中提取控制律，并在数值算例中与多种基准方法比较，展示该凸优化框架的可计算性与有效性。
papers.abstract_en: The paper addresses the optimal control problem of an input-affine polynomial system with an unknown (state-dependent) input matrix affecting the control effectiveness. Under assumptions on the existence of a data set and the Lipschitz continuity of the unknown part {of the dynamics}, an uncertainty set is constructed and used to adapt the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation towards a data-driven formulation. We solve it for the best-case scenario, thus giving a lower bound on the best cost achievable by means of a feedback control policy. After relaxing it into a moment-SoS hierarchy of semidefinite programs, a control law is extracted from the primal on moments and compared with other benchmark methods in a numerical application.

papers.title_en: DynaMimic: A Physics-Informed World Model for Humanoid Motion Tracking
papers.authors: Chaoyue Xing, Linyi Huang, Yiting He, Yixuan Yin, Siqi Hou, Yi Zhang, Liyuan Pan, Miaomiao Liu, Daqi Liu
papers.evidence: 面向人形机器人全身运动跟踪的物理信息世界模型
papers.tldr: 全身运动跟踪让人形机器人复现人类技能，但现有模型无关强化学习要么蒸馏专家损失性能，要么依赖大规模计算。DynaMimic将共享物理显式嵌入可微世界模型，预测各候选支撑连杆的接触力旋量与残余广义力，再用拉格朗日前向动力学闭式计算下一状态。在60个LAFAN1动作上，其平均每关节位置误差较SuperMimic降低18.6%，并在A3 Parkour与GRAIL地形片段上分别降低14.9%和10.8%。真机A3还能完成倒地恢复、侧手翻和箱体翻越等多样技能。
papers.abstract_en: Whole-body motion tracking enables humanoid robots to reproduce diverse skills from human demonstrations. Existing model-free reinforcement learning methods either distill motion specialists into a single policy at the cost of performance or train a generalist policy directly using cluster-scale computation. SuperMimic reduces this computational cost through a differentiable world model that implicitly learns the physics shared across motions by predicting the next state from the current state and action. However, this implicit formulation may not fully capture the underlying physical processes. Errors around changes of support can accumulate over imagined rollouts used to train the tracking policy. To address this challenge, we introduce DynaMimic, a differentiable world model that explicitly incorporates shared physics into state prediction. Specifically, its network predicts a contact wrench at each candidate support link and a residual generalized force. DynaMimic then uses these predictions to compute the next state through closed-form Lagrangian forward dynamics. Across 60 full LAFAN1 motions, DynaMimic reduces mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) by 18.6% relative to SuperMimic. For terrain tracking, we give both methods the same local height maps. Relative to terrain-conditioned SuperMimic, DynaMimic reduces MPJPE by 14.9% on A3 Parkour (66.15 to 56.28~mm) and by 10.8% on GRAIL terrain clips (141.88 to 126.57~mm). On a real A3 humanoid, the learned policies can perform diverse skills, such as floor recovery, cartwheel and a box vault.

papers.title_en: SOC-Net: Second-Order-Cone-Constrained Neural Networks
papers.authors: Seungseok Oh, Youngjae Min, Navid Azizan, Namhoon Cho
papers.evidence: 网络结构内嵌输入相关二阶锥约束
papers.tldr: 神经网络常需满足物理、安全与操作限制，这类输入相关二阶锥约束在控制中常见，但现有方法依赖锥求解器、迭代收敛或逐输入内点。SOC-Net将骨干输出的仿射提升投影到固定Lorentz锥乘积的可达切片，并把修正映射回输出空间，从而按构造保证任意输入可行。实验在摩擦接触力分配和输入鲁棒CBF三维避障中全部满足约束，且评估延迟低于求解器与迭代基线。该工作为一般SOC约束提供可端到端训练、分布外仍可行的网络架构。
papers.abstract_en: In many applications, neural networks must learn input-output maps that respect prior knowledge such as physical laws, safety requirements, and operating limits. These requirements constrain which outputs are admissible for a given input and often admit second-order cone (SOC) representations, including norm bounds and robust linear inequalities. Examples in control include friction cones, thrust bounds, and input-robust control barrier function (CBF) conditions. However, existing approaches to enforcing general input-dependent SOC constraints require a conic solver, an iterative scheme whose feasibility depends on convergence, or an interior feasible point for each input. We propose SOC-Net, a neural network architecture that enforces input-dependent SOC constraints by construction for every input, even outside the training distribution. SOC-Net projects an affine lifting of the backbone output onto the reachable slice of a fixed product of Lorentz cones and maps the correction back to the output space. For separable constraints, this projection splits into one projection per cone, and each is available in closed form or reduces to a single scalar equation, regardless of the cone dimension. We prove that SOC-Net retains the expressive power of the backbone network under regularity conditions and accommodates end-to-end training by standard backpropagation with an explicit Jacobian. Experiments on contact force allocation with friction constraints and 3-D obstacle avoidance with an input-robust CBF demonstrate that SOC-Net satisfies the constraints at every evaluated input, with lower evaluation latency than the tested solver-based and iterative baselines.

papers.title_en: Curvature-Equilibrated Policy Optimization for Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Gang Chen
papers.evidence: 面向深度强化学习的曲率感知策略优化
papers.tldr: 基于梯度的actor优化是深度强化学习的核心，但常规一阶优化器未显式利用actor损失的局部曲率。本文提出EQUIP，通过均衡正负曲率来平衡参数空间的局部收缩与扩张，并用投影Hessian构造有界局部度量。方法在保持一阶损失下降的同时调整梯度方向，实验表明能改进策略搜索效果，为深度RL的策略优化提供了曲率感知的新工具。
papers.abstract_en: Gradient-based actor optimization is central to deep reinforcement learning. However, conventional first-order optimizers do not explicitly exploit the local curvature of neural actor losses. We propose EQUIP (Curvature-Equilibrated Gradients for Policy Search), a novel approach that seeks to balance local contraction and expansion of the actor parameter space by equilibrating positive and negative curvature. EQUIP constructs a trajectory-informed search subspace and uses the projected Hessian of actor loss to build a bounded local metric for curvature equilibration. First-order loss matching preserves the approximated first-order decrease in actor loss. Meanwhile, gradient mixing and curvature-based gradient selection adjust the gradient applied for actor optimization. We establish the geometric properties of curvature equilibration, derive bounds on gradient alignment and magnitude, and identify conditions for improved actor loss reduction and convergence toward stationarity under direct gradient updates. We integrate EQUIP into Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) without modifying its actor loss, critic learning, or replay mechanism. Experiments on 6 MuJoCo continuous control benchmarks show that the resulting EQUIP-SAC algorithm achieves higher mean sample efficiency than SAC and two second-order policy optimization baselines. Ablation studies further highlight the benefits of curvature equilibration and trajectory-informed geometry for policy training.

papers.title_en: POISE: Curvature-Aware Critic Regularization for Smooth Actor-Critic Control
papers.authors: Jeong Woon Lee, Namho Kim, Hyoseok Hwang
papers.evidence: actor-critic控制中的曲率感知评论家正则化
papers.tldr: 针对actor-critic方法虽回报高但动作高频振荡的问题，本文不约束actor而转向正则化critic。作者提出曲率感知的评论家正则化方法，分别惩罚动作梯度变化并鼓励负曲率，同时用贪心位移刻画动作漂移。分析表明该方法能更准确衡量位移的价值后果，从而获得更平滑且高性能的机器人控制策略。
papers.abstract_en: Actor-critic methods achieve high returns in robotic control, yet trained actors exhibit high-frequency action oscillations. Most smoothness methods constrain the actor, whereas PAVE regularizes the critic by separately penalizing action-gradient variation and encouraging negative action curvature. The same gradient change, however, moves the critic's preferred action farther where the critic is flat, and separate penalties do not measure this motion. We characterize this motion through the greedy shift, which approximates greedy-action displacement across state transitions to first order under local concavity. Since displacement alone does not reflect its critic-value consequences, the analysis further shows that the shift's curvature-weighted energy approximates the value lost by retaining the previous greedy action to second order. Based on this relationship, POISE regularizes the curvature-weighted energy along temporal and spatial state displacements. It employs a saddle-free curvature metric and reward-scale-consistent scaling while leaving the actor unchanged. On six continuous control tasks with TD3, POISE reduces the smoothness score on every task by $5.9\times$ on average ($4.5\times$ geometric mean), compared with $2.2\times$ ($1.9\times$) for the strongest baseline, and achieves the lowest score on five tasks. Paired return intervals include zero on four tasks, with a 14% increase on Ant and an 11% decrease on Hopper.

papers.title_en: BARE: Body-Aware Reflexive Evasion for Humanoid Robots
papers.authors: Zihao Li, Tong Chen, Hua Song, Zitong Ding, Zihao Xu, Ce Hao, Weibang Bai
papers.evidence: 人形机器人反射式躲避运动控制
papers.tldr: 动态避障对人形机器人安全部署至关重要，但局部身体调整会改变质量分布与支撑条件，难以兼顾快速躲避与全身稳定。本文提出BARE，利用人形丰富关节做小范围局部调整，只移动受威胁身体区域而无需整体重定位。该方法面向快速反射式躲避并力图维持全身稳定性，为人形机器人的实时运动控制提供了新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic obstacle avoidance is essential for safely deploying humanoid robots in real-world environments, where rapidly approaching objects require immediate evasive responses. Recent advances in reflexive evasion have focused primarily on quadrupeds, which typically rely on large-scale whole-body maneuvers. In contrast, humanoids can exploit their rich body articulation to evade through small, localized body adjustments. By moving threatened body regions without repositioning the entire body, these responses may require less execution time and less surrounding free space. However, local adjustments can alter mass distribution or support conditions, making it challenging to achieve rapid evasion while maintaining whole-body stability. To this end, we propose BARE (Body-Aware Reflexive Evasion), a humanoid reflexive evasion framework guided by human motion priors that enables rapid local evasion while maintaining whole-body stability. A risk-guided motion adapter is designed to select reference motions from a retargeted human evasive motion library based on the threatened body region and to adjust their temporal phases based on collision urgency, allowing the robot to reach evasive postures before potential contact. Conditioned on the adapted reference and link-level collision risk, a reflexive evasion policy learns through reinforcement learning to coordinate local body adjustments with whole-body stabilization. We validate BARE in simulation and real-world experiments, demonstrating its ability to perform targeted local evasion while maintaining whole-body stability.

papers.title_en: DiffGR00T: Execution-Aware Differentiable Training for Humanoid Whole-Body Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Sichen Wu, Qian Sun, Mengfan Liu, Weikai Qin, Bike Zhu, Hesheng Wang
papers.evidence: 基于学习式世界模型的人形全身VLA可微训练
papers.tldr: 人形全身控制要求动态平衡与全身协调，而现有多层式人形视觉-语言-动作模型把动作生成与物理执行分离，导致跟踪和平衡误差无法直接优化生成器。本文提出DiffGR00T，将GR00T N1.7与全身行为基础模型SONIC耦合，并以学习的动作条件世界模型取代不可微仿真器，从而支持端到端可微训练。该设计让多步身体执行损失回传至VLA生成器，提升了全身动作生成的执行感知能力。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved strong results in arm-centric manipulation, yet humanoid whole-body control (WBC) requires dynamic balance and tightly coupled full-body coordination. Existing hierarchical humanoid VLAs typically decouple motion generation from physical execution, leaving tracking and balance errors unable to directly optimize the VLA generator. We propose DiffGR00T, an end-to-end differentiable training framework that couples GR00T N1.7 with SONIC, a pretrained whole-body behavior foundation model. To enable execution-aware differentiable training, we replace the non-differentiable simulator with a learned, action-conditioned world model, allowing multi-step body-execution losses to backpropagate through the frozen whole-body controller and the flow-matching sampler directly into the VLA action head. On four HumanoidArena simulation tasks, DiffGR00T improves average task success by 12.5 percentage points over the supervised base VLA (59.2% to 71.7%), demonstrating that execution-aware gradients effectively align high-level motion generation with closed-loop whole-body dynamics.

papers.title_en: Simultaneously Boosting Efficiency and Capability for Linear Attention via Adaptive Channel Compression and Activation Purification
papers.authors: Senqi Guan, Xianchao Zhang, Moyan Tian, Linlin Zong, Wenxin Liang, Xinyue Liu
papers.evidence: 自适应通道压缩的高效线性注意力降低计算通道数
papers.tldr: 自注意力的二次复杂度是视觉 Transformer 的核心瓶颈，而现有线性注意力等高效方案往往牺牲表征能力导致性能下降。本文在线性注意力的 QKV 投影中首次嵌入自适应通道压缩与激活净化机制，使模型在减少计算通道的同时保留高维特征信息，并融合聚焦核函数。该设计缓解了效率与能力的矛盾，属于高效网络结构优化与注意力机制改进。
papers.abstract_en: Self-attention's quadratic complexity constitutes a core bottleneck for Vision Transformers (ViTs). Existing efficiency-oriented optimizations, including softmax-based and linear attention (LA) variants, generally compromise model representational capacity, leading to inevitable performance degradation. We propose a novel linear attention which alleviates this efficiency-capability dilemma. For the first time, we embed an Adaptive Channel Compression and Activation Purification (ACCAP) mechanism into the QKV projection of linear attention, which enables the model to retain high-dimensional feature information while performing computations with reduced channels. We further fuse a focused kernel function and a self-gating module into ACCAP to construct a lightweight linear attention module (ACCAP-LA). Our theoretical analysis shows that, compared to standard linear attention, ACCAP-LA reduces the attention module's parameter count by 79.17% and FLOPs by 77.5%. Extensive experiments demonstrate ACCAP-LA's effectiveness: when applied to ViT, it achieves 79.4% Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K with only 5.8M parameters, and more notably, it boasts strong cross-architecture compatibility, boosting EfficientViT-b1 and PVT-T by 3.3% and 3.4% respectively.

papers.title_en: PGX: Physically Grounded Execution for Long-Horizon Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.authors: Kai Lu, Chenyang Ma, Ioannis Havoutis
papers.evidence: 结合经典控制组件的人形机器人长时程移动操作
papers.tldr: 视觉-语言-动作模型虽能执行单一操作技能，但在长时程人形机器人移动操作中难以兼顾时序结构与精度。PGX将时序与精度控制卸载到两个免训练的经典组件，并用谓词状态机管理任务推进、恢复与导航等待。实验表明该分层框架提升了长时程移动操作任务的稳定性与成功率。其贡献在于把经典控制与学习模型解耦组合，为复杂移动操作提供可扩展方案。
papers.abstract_en: Robotic vision-language-action (VLA) models can execute diverse individual manipulation skills, yet they still struggle with long-horizon loco-manipulation tasks, where temporal structure, skills, and precision are tightly coupled within a monolithic model. We propose Physically Grounded Execution (PGX), a framework that offloads temporal and precision control to two classical training-free components, allowing the VLA to focus on stage-specific skill dynamics. PGX decomposes long-horizon loco-manipulation into three layers: (i) a predicate-based state machine governs task progression, using physical predicates to gate phase transitions, trigger recovery, and coordinate navigation and waiting. Shared predicate semantics connect offline demonstration segmentation, online execution, and stage-wise evaluation; (ii) VLA skills operate within active manipulation phases, with flat or stage-trained models concentrating on task-relevant actions; and (iii) world-coordinate locking (WCL) maintains spatial consistency through base station keeping, object-relative positioning, and world-anchored contact targets. We demonstrate the effectiveness of PGX with extensive experiments conducted on three simulated tasks and one real-world task using a Unitree G1 humanoid robot for long-horizon loco-manipulation, showing improvements in stage progression and task success rates. Project page is available at: https://kl-research.github.io/pgx

papers.title_en: SUAF: Spectral Universal Advantage Features for Zero-Shot Policy Improvement
papers.authors: Huaze Tang, Runqing Miao, Tianren Peng, Lam Nguyen, Chao Wang, Jairong Li, Wenbo Ding
papers.evidence: 面向强化学习零样本策略改进的谱优势特征
papers.tldr: 针对奖励无关表示容量有限、难以支撑跨任务策略改进的问题。提出构造以动作为中心的正滞后典型依赖矩阵，并通过奇异值分解得到谱通用优势特征。方法分离出当前动作相对状态的额外预测贡献。实现零样本策略改进，为强化学习可复用表示设计提供新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Reward-independent representations enable reinforcement learning agents to reuse knowledge across tasks, but limited representation capacity raises three fundamental questions: what statistical dependence should these representations capture, which components of that dependence should be retained for policy improvement, and how does discarding the remaining components affect decision-making? We address these questions through canonical dependence analysis. For a reference policy, we construct an action-centered, positive-lag canonical dependence matrix (CDM) that isolates the additional predictive contribution of the current action beyond the current state. Its singular value decomposition yields Spectral Universal Advantage Features (SUAF), paired features that recover delayed advantage through linear reward projections. We show that the spectrum quantifies mutual information between current action and future state-action visitation conditioned on current state and determines reward specific approximation errors. Retaining the leading modes gives optimal rank-constrained approximations under both isotropic average-case and reward-uniform minimax criteria. Separating the immediate reward contrast also avoids the spectral floor arising from direct compression of the full advantage operator. To learn SUAF from reward-free data, we develop an action-centered Soft-HGR objective with bidirectional temporal-difference estimation. We further connect spectral approximation errors to sufficient conditions for policy improvement. Finite-state experiments validate the spectral predictions and feature-learning method, while zero-shot evaluations on discrete tasks and continuous-control benchmarks demonstrate the utility of the learned representations across rewards.

papers.title_en: Fast World Planner: Advantage-Aware Action-Chunk Policy for Online Planning
papers.authors: Jiangtao Kong, Yuchen Wang, Yandong Luo, Rongchao Xu, Guang Wang, Yanbing Mao, Lu Gan, Tianyi Zhou, Huajie Shao
papers.evidence: 面向在线规划的优势感知MPPI模型强化学习策略引导
papers.tldr: MPPI是模型强化学习在线规划的核心，但迭代细化导致规划延迟，而减少迭代会降低性能，已有方法仅在动作层面对齐规划器。作者提出SWAN，一个优势感知的MPPI模型强化学习框架，显式表示并改进完整的H步规划提案，以更好地引导策略学习。实验表明该方法在保持规划质量的同时降低在线规划延迟，为实时模型强化学习控制提供了新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control is central to online planning for model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL), but its iterative refinement incurs planning latency. Reducing refinement iterations often degrades performance, motivating stronger policy guidance learned from the planner. However, existing methods typically learn from the planner through action-level alignment, which does not directly capture the complete $H$-step planner proposal. Moreover, planner imitation leaves further target improvement to online refinement. To address these limitations, we propose FaSt World PlANner (SWAN), an advantage-aware MPPI-based MBRL framework that explicitly represents and improves the complete $H$-step planner proposal to improve policy guidance for efficient online planning. For proposal representation, SWAN combines k-MPPI, a multimodal MPPI extension, with a mixture of factor analyzers (MFA) action-chunk policy to capture multiple modes and correlations across time and action dimensions. For proposal optimization, we introduce Advantage-Guided Proposal Optimization (APO), which reuses MPPI evaluations to construct an improved target using advantage estimates and trains the policy toward this target while preserving planner alignment. Experiments across 31 high-dimensional continuous-control tasks from DMControl, HumanoidBench, and MyoSuite show that SWAN substantially improves control performance and sample efficiency while using 50% fewer MPPI refinement iterations than state-of-the-art planning-based MBRL methods. Finally, SWAN demonstrates zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on a physical Unitree Go2, achieving stable velocity-tracking locomotion with high-frequency control. (see our demo at https://swanfastworldplanner.github.io/)

papers.title_en: Decoding Transformer Dynamics via Koopman Subspaces
papers.authors: Subhradeep Kayal, Ali Dashti
papers.evidence: Koopman算子理论与DMD用于动力系统分析
papers.tldr: 为刻画大语言模型处理不同主题输入时的逐层隐状态演化，作者将层间演化视为动力系统，用Koopman算子理论与动态模态分解拟合线性算子，并取主模态张成的子空间作为主题谱指纹。实验显示单线性算子可将下一层状态预测到约18%相对误差、解释方差约0.99，指纹在57个MMLU学科上具有主题判别性。该工作说明Koopman谱指纹可作为可复现的模型行为分析工具。
papers.abstract_en: We apply Koopman operator theory and Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD) to characterise how large language models (LLMs) process different input topics. Treating the layer-to-layer evolution of hidden states as a dynamical system, we fit a linear Koopman operator and take the subspace spanned by its dominant modes as a per-topic spectral fingerprint. Four findings emerge. First, the depth map is near-linear: a single linear operator predicts each next-layer state to within approx. 18% relative error (interior variance explained approx. 0.99). Second, over the 57 MMLU subjects the fingerprint is topic-discriminative, matching the MMLU taxonomy at 0.72 nearest-neighbour purity and each subject's semantic neighbourhood at 0.75 any-hit@3. Third, it is a reproducible signature (split-half self-retrieval approx. 0.97$). Finally, these findings are consistent across seven base models (Qwen2.5 0.5-7B, Llama-3 1-8B), with a suggestive trend of alignment rising with MMLU accuracy. The spectral fingerprint thus provides a probe of how transformers process different topics across depth. Code is available at https://github.com/DeepK/koopman-llm-eacl27.

papers.title_en: Near-Optimal Smooth Convex Optimization with a Comparison Oracle
papers.authors: Peter Richtárik, Ammar Mahran
papers.evidence: 近最优光滑凸优化方法
papers.tldr: 针对仅有比较预言机时凸函数最小化的高效算法设计难题，论文研究L-Lipschitz梯度凸函数的最小化。方法基于归一化的Nemirovski子空间方法，每次迭代沿估计梯度方向做线搜索并在二维仿射子空间上最小化。作者给出确定性方法，以近最优的比较次数返回ε最优解，为仅依赖比较信息的凸优化提供了复杂度保证。
papers.abstract_en: We study the minimization of a convex $d$-dimensional function with $L$-Lipschitz gradient when the only available information is a comparison oracle that reports which of two points has the smaller objective value. Given an initial point within distance $R$ of a minimizer, the constants $L$ and $R$, and $A = LR^2/\varepsilon$, we give a deterministic method that returns an $\varepsilon$-optimal point using $O(\sqrt{A}\,[d\log(2dA)+\log^2(2A)])$ comparisons for $A\ge1$, counting all comparisons spent in inner subroutines. The method is based on a normalized variant of Nemirovski's subspace method: each iteration performs a line search along an estimated gradient direction followed by a minimization over a two-dimensional affine subspace, and both subroutines rely on a comparison oracle and basic arithmetic operations only. With exact function values, combining finite-difference gradients with an accelerated method gives the well-known bound of $O(d\sqrt{A})$ evaluations; our bound shows that one bit per query suffices to match it up to logarithmic factors. Since two function values determine one comparison, the exact function-value lower bound of Dorn et al. implies that our bound is optimal up to logarithmic factors when $32\le A\le d^2$.

papers.title_en: JEPA-Shield: Safe Diffusion Planning with Latent World Models via Conformal Shielding
papers.authors: Taekyung Kim, Ege Yuceel, Steven Hong, Georgios Fainekos, Dimitra Panagou, Bardh Hoxha
papers.evidence: 对规划轨迹强制物理约束的安全屏蔽
papers.tldr: 潜世界模型虽能基于图像进行规划，却无法直接判定机器人是否满足物理约束。作者提出JEPA-Shield，把冻结的JEPA世界模型与任务空间安全约束衔接，用分裂共形预测将端到端运动预测误差转为多步不确定管，再由备份式屏蔽在采样型模型预测控制中筛除不安全轨迹。该方法为世界模型规划提供了可验证的安全保障。
papers.abstract_en: Latent world models enable planning from images, but their predictions do not directly establish whether a robot will satisfy physical constraints. We present JEPA-Shield, which connects a frozen action-conditioned Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) world model to task-space safety enforcement. Two downstream models predict relative motion from imagined latent rollouts and decode unsafe geometry from the current image. Split conformal prediction turns end-to-end motion-prediction errors into multi-horizon uncertainty tubes. A backup-based shield checks these tubes against physical constraints and screens both candidate trajectories and final proposals in diffusion-inspired sampling-based model predictive control. Under the stated exchangeability and initial-backup assumptions, we establish probabilistic constraint satisfaction at action-block boundaries for a returned plan executed without replanning. We also introduce VParkBench, with geometric car and tractor-trailer parking tasks and a editable photorealistic Gaussian-splatting environment. In closed-loop evaluation, JEPA-Shield achieves success rates of 84.4%, 82.3%, and 99.0%, respectively, with no observed constraint violations. Ablations show complementary benefits from shielding and uncertainty calibration. The results demonstrate the importance of grounding latent world-model predictions in task-space quantities and explicitly accounting for prediction uncertainty in safety-critical planning.

papers.title_en: CarlHOI: Counterfactual Predictive Imagination for Generalizable Multi-Humanoid Object Interaction under Constrained Environments
papers.authors: Wenjie Lin, Jin Wei-Kocsis
papers.evidence: 结合关系潜变量世界模型的多机器人协同控制
papers.tldr: 基于物理仿真的人形控制已能让不同规模团队协同搬运物体，但遇到需绕行和队形变化的未知环境约束时，已学协同策略难以泛化。本文提出CarlHOI，构建反事实锚定的关系潜变量世界模型CarlWM来刻画人-物交互，并通过反事实预测想象实现无需重训练的适应。该框架使多人形团队能在未见约束下调整队形与路径，提升了协同操作的泛化能力。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in physics-based humanoid control enable teams of varying sizes to coordinate their movements and cooperatively transport shared objects. However, adapting learned cooperative behaviors to unseen environmental constraints remains challenging, particularly when obstacles require coordinated detours and changes in team configuration. We propose CarlHOI, a counterfactual predictive imagination framework built upon a counterfactual-anchored relational latent world model (CarlWM) for human-object interaction (HOI), enabling multi-humanoid teams to adapt to unseen environmental constraints without retraining their underlying cooperative control policies. CarlHOI explicitly represents the shared object, individual humanoids, and environmental obstacles as interacting entities. Trained offline using counterfactual simulator rollouts, the model imagines alternative collective futures under different shared waypoint commands, predicting how the coupled humanoid team and object would respond. By evaluating these imagined outcomes through predicted progress, failure, and contact risks, and long-horizon value estimates, CarlHOI selects adaptive guidance commands while preserving the pretrained cooperative controller. We introduce a benchmark comprising three challenging obstacle-constrained transport tasks to evaluate adaptation and generalization. Despite being trained exclusively with four humanoids, our model generalizes without retraining to teams of two to ten humanoids, unseen obstacle geometries and placements, unseen objects, and novel combinations of environmental constraints. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved cooperative transport success over evaluated baselines across diverse configurations. Results highlight the potential of counterfactual predictive imagination to extend pretrained multi-humanoid cooperative skills beyond their original training conditions.

papers.title_en: Particle Belief Representations for Reinforcement Learning under Partial Observability
papers.authors: Himanshu Gupta, Brendan Crowe, Christoffer Heckman, Bradley Hayes, Zachary Sunberg
papers.evidence: 部分可观测下的粒子信念编码用于决策
papers.tldr: 部分可观测环境下粒子滤波能表示多模态信念，但其以加权无序集合形式输出，与常规定维策略网络不兼容。作者在固定信念估计与策略优化的前提下，比较统计摘要、累积量生成函数特征与置换不变集合编码器作为策略输入的编码方式，并考察端到端与预训练两种学习方式。在八个任务上，池化集合编码与梯度CGF特征端到端可靠，而适当预训练的Set Transformer性能最佳。该研究为不确定性下的信念表示选择提供了系统性的实证依据。
papers.abstract_en: Particle filters flexibly represent complex, multimodal beliefs but expose them as weighted, unordered sets incompatible with conventional fixed-dimensional policies. We study particle-belief encodings as inputs to reinforcement-learning policies while holding belief estimation and policy optimization fixed. We compare statistical summaries, cumulant-generating-function (CGF) features, and permutation-invariant set encoders. Trainable encoders are learned end-to-end or pretrained through belief reconstruction or task-specific prediction. Across eight tasks, pooling-based set encoders and gradient CGF features are reliable end-to-end, while the Set Transformer achieves the highest performance with appropriate pretraining. Task-specific pretraining helps when its target captures decision-relevant belief structure, whereas reconstruction pretraining and latent alignment provide more selective benefits. For selecting and training particle-belief encoders in partially observable Markov decision processes, our results show that an encoding that reconstructs the belief well is not necessarily a good input for control.

papers.title_en: OVOGO: Offline Value-Guided On-Policy Generative Optimization for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Rongzheng Yang, Jiaming Guo, Yuxuan Guo, Zihao Zhang, Yunkai Gao, Siming Lan, Shaohui Peng, Rui Zhang, Tianyun Ma, Xing Hu, Yunji Chen
papers.evidence: 离线价值学习与在策略优化分离
papers.tldr: 针对流式视觉-语言-动作模型反复物理交互成本高的问题，提出OVOGO离线强化学习框架，将离线价值学习与在策略生成优化解耦，并利用流式策略可在重放观测处廉价重采样生成轨迹的特性训练评论家。实验表明该框架能在不新增交互的情况下提升策略性能，为机器人策略的持续改进提供了低成本方案。
papers.abstract_en: Flow-based vision-language-action models can benefit from robot experience collected during deployment, but repeatedly acquiring new physical interactions for policy improvement is costly. Offline reinforcement learning provides a natural way to reuse collected experience, while flow-based policies offer an additional opportunity because fresh generation trajectories can be cheaply resampled from the current policy at replay observations. This motivates separating offline value learning from on-policy optimization of the generative process. We propose OVOGO, an offline reinforcement learning framework that realizes this separation for flow-based VLAs. A central challenge in this formulation is to learn a critic that remains grounded in logged robot experience while providing useful value signals for newly generated actions. OVOGO introduces a Return-Anchored Ranking Critic that combines in-sample distributional value learning with guarded local ranking, improving discrimination among generated actions without assigning them artificial return targets. The frozen critic then provides group-relative value signals for selected-transition optimization of fresh action candidates sampled from the current flow policy. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0, DexJoCo, and LIBERO, as well as a real-robot dexterous manipulation task, show that OVOGO improves the initial VLA across all four settings and achieves higher success rates than the evaluated offline adaptation and value-guided baselines. These results suggest that offline robot experience can be repeatedly reused for value learning while inexpensive generative sampling supports policy optimization, providing an effective approach to experience-based post-training of flow-based VLAs.
